text:
alex: CI on PR #11942 failed the microbench threshold for cold-start latency. seen on x86-prod-runner-7.
ci-bot: PR 11942 — microbench: kv_coldstart_latency exceeded threshold (run id: 2026-03-18T12:04Z)
ryan: link to the CI artifact?
ci-bot: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/11942/kv_coldstart/2026-03-18T12-04.log
jen: quick looked: base=23.1ms PR=38.0ms delta=+64%  (threshold is +10%). definitely noisy.
mia: Ack. that's large. Is this warmup/kernels or batching priming?
sam: I ran the microbench locally with the baseline and PR build:
```
./ci/perf/run_microbench --bench kv_coldstart --runs 50 --compare baseline.json pr_build.json
# summary
kv_coldstart_ms: baseline=23.1 PR=37.9 delta=+14.8 (64.1%) p=0.0003
```
ryan: good repro. Any perf profile artifacts in the CI log?
ci-bot: uploaded perf profiles: s3://redwood-ci/11942/kv_coldstart/profiles.tar.gz
jen: grabbing the flamegraph now. my quick take: lots more GPU kernel invocation during step 0 on PR. looks like PR touched kernel selection path for quantized models.
alex: PR touches kernel-autoselect heuristics + a small caching reorder. could be a regression where first request triggers an expensive kernel compile path that used to be avoided.
mia: If it is compile-on-first-use we should see a one-off spike, but our bench runs multiple processes. Is the delta persistent across repeated runs?
sam: I re-ran 10x sequentially on the PR build: 37.9, 36.8, 37.5, 37.1, 36.9, 37.2, 37.0, 37.6, 36.7, 37.3 -> stable. Not just first-request.
ryan: OK not compile-once then. Could be kernel selection falling back to a slower kernel due to altered affinity/heuristic thresholds.
jen: I bisected locally: narrowed to commit 8a3f9d4 (merge from feature/quant-autoselect).
jen: git bisect log -> 8a3f9d4 flips autoselect threshold to prefer fallback kernels when seq_len < 32.
alex: That change was meant to avoid jitter on long sequences but might make tiny-seq paths choose slower kernels.
mia: Suggest a quick revert patch that restores previous threshold while we investigate. Can someone open the emergency revert PR?
sam: I'll draft the revert: PR #11944 (revert 8a3f9d4). Running quick CI with revert to validate.
ci-bot: queued PR 11944 — running microbenchers (expect ~15m).
ryan: Also add a regression unit test that runs kv_coldstart bench on small seqs and asserts <= +10% vs baseline.
jen: Yep adding the test in the same revert PR.
alex: Filing an infra followup to add kernel-selection telemetry in perf CI (which kernel variant used per-run). this would catch future regressions faster.
mia: For postmortem: capture perf profiles and a short note on why the threshold change mattered (link to commit discussion).
jen: tl;dr: sympathetic revert in progress. will update when CI for 11944 finishes. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: PR 11944 CI results: microbench kv_coldstart -> baseline=23.2 PR=23.5 delta=+1.3% ✅
alex: Great. Revert validated. Leaving issue open for a targeted fix to keep long-seq stability without regressing small-seq hotpath.
ryan: Thanks all. assigning follow-up to @mia for root-cause writeup and to @jen for test coverage.
mia: assigned. will drop summary in eng-runtime later today.
jen: closing loop after change re-landed with better heuristics. :lock:
